title: France-Bangladesh Joint Venture Excavations at Mahasthangarh: First Interim Report 1993-1999
seoDescription: Archaeological excavation report by the France-Bangladesh mission at Mahasthangarh, useful for cultural sequence and urban archaeology.
note: Excavation report from the France-Bangladesh archaeological mission at Mahasthangarh, cited in Banglapedia for the site sequence and investigation history.
attribution: Shafiqul Alam and J.-F. Salles, eds.
whyItMatters: It is a specialist excavation report for evaluating the cultural sequence, urban layout, and material evidence behind Mahasthangarh chronology.
